title: Linux_NyaDrop_Incident_Response_Scenario_bee
description: Investigate and respond to a potential security incident involving the Linux/NyaDrop malware on a victim host.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim host in your network has exhibited unusual behavior, including unexpected network connections and suspicious file modifications. Your task is to investigate and respond to this potential security incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation

levels.title: Investigate the victim host for unauthorized or suspicious services
levels.content:
Investigate the victim host for unauthorized or suspicious services.

Objective: Enumerate running services and distinguish legitimate services from malicious ones.
levels.solution: Check the status of all services and look for any that appear unusual or unauthorized. The flag value is 'nyadrop.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: To identify suspicious services, run the following command: 'systemctl list-units --type=service'. Look for any services that appear unusual or unauthorized.

levels.title: Determine if any scheduled tasks or timers are responsible for automatically executing suspicious activity
levels.content:
Determine if any scheduled tasks or timers are responsible for automatically executing suspicious activity.

Objective: Identify scheduled execution persistence mechanisms.
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd timers and services to find any that might be related to the suspicious activity. The flag value is 'nyadrop.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: To identify suspicious timers, run the following command: 'systemctl list-timers'. Look for any timers that appear unusual or unauthorized.

levels.title: Locate files introduced onto the system by the malicious software
levels.content:
Locate files introduced onto the system by the malicious software.

Objective: Correlate suspicious activity with newly created files and identify malware artifacts.
levels.solution: Search for recently modified or created files in unusual directories. The flag value is '/tmp/.session/rat.sh'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: To locate suspicious files, run the following command: 'find / -type f -mtime -1'. Look for any files that appear unusual or unauthorized.
